name: Son of the Woods
source:
Hippolytus, young prince of Athens and son of Theseus, has been confessed to by his step-mother. Horrified by those incestuous feelings, he runs away, to find peace in the woods he is used to hunt in. But as he tries to cope with the situation he just went through, a question arises in his mind: when Phaedra, his step-mother, after revealing her passion, begged him to stab her... why did Hippolytus not kill her?

[From [url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/son-of-the-woods]itch.io[/url]]
translation:
希波吕托斯（Hippolytus），年轻的雅典王子，忒修斯的儿子，被他的继母承认了。被这些乱伦的感觉吓坏了，他逃跑了，在他习惯打猎的树林里寻找平静。但当他试图应对他刚刚经历的情况时，他的脑海中出现了一个问题：当他的继母菲德拉在透露了她的激情后，恳求他刺伤她……为什么希波吕托斯不杀了她？

[来自[url=https://chimeriquement.itch.io/son-of-the-woods]itch.io[/url]]
